tasks.short: Prepare, administer and grade tests and assignments.

steps.what: Prepare tests and assignments that evaluate these students' progress.
Administer those tests and assignments in class.
Grade the completed tests and assignments.

tasks.design: She prepares the tests and assignments, administers them in class, and grades the completed work herself. No tool is added, and nothing is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The mark depends on reading what the student wrote and on what that student can show.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes giving the test or deciding the mark.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong mark can harm the student, and she remains accountable for it.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the completed work shows about progress.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still prepares the tests, gives them, and grades them.

reach.task: Lay out the test paper before the class sits down.
reach.learn: Which students need a reader or extra time on this assignment.

evidence.claim: In October 2026, 7 percent of secondary teachers used AI for marking.
AI that evaluates learning outcomes is high-risk.

assumptions: Her boundary is this class. She prepares, gives and grades the tests here, and she does not send a mark outside the organisation.
The mark records the student, the assignment and the result. She writes them from the completed work. An empty answer stays empty.
Writing the mark is her own entry inside the organisation. It is not a machine commit.
Upkeep is zero because no tool is added. Share 32 is preparing the tests (documents 31.6), share 52 is giving them (in-person prior 51.2), and share 16 is grading (the other means together 17.2).
unknowns: Whether closed answers on these tests are already marked by an answer key before she reads them.
research_questions: Which tests in this class are closed items, and which must she read?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Preparing, giving and grading the tests stay as they are. A week with the same assignments still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare assigned classes and show written evidence of preparation.

steps.what: Write the written evidence of preparation when immediate supervisors request it.

tasks.design: She prepares the assigned class, then writes the evidence of that preparation when a supervisor asks to see it. No tool is added, and nothing is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The lesson has to fit the impairments in this class, and the supervisor asks to see that preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new writes the lesson for these students.
tasks.still_hard: A plan that ignores an impairment wastes the lesson.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what this class will do.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still prepares the class and writes the evidence.

reach.task: Ask for the written evidence of preparation for this class.
reach.learn: Which lesson aim the teacher set for these students.

evidence.claim: Preparing the class and writing the evidence of preparation stay with the teacher.
Oak's Aila cut weekly preparation from 3.3 to 2.5 hours, covered 7 percent of lessons, and use declined over ten weeks.

assumptions: Her boundary is the assigned class and the written evidence a supervisor in the organisation can read. She does not send the plan outside the organisation.
The written evidence records the class, the lesson aim and the activity. She writes them. An empty activity stays empty.
Writing that evidence is her own entry inside the organisation. It is not a machine commit.

Upkeep is zero because no tool is added. Share 34 is preparing the class (in-person prior 33.3). Share 66 is the written evidence (documents 50.6 and the other means together 16.1). A planning assistant that covered a small share of other teachers' lessons is not this class's preparation.
unknowns: Whether the supervisor accepts the evidence only when she wrote every activity herself.
research_questions: What must the written evidence of preparation contain for the immediate supervisor?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Preparing the class and writing the evidence stay as they are. A week of the same classes still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer standardized tests and interpret strengths and needs.

steps.what: Administer standardized ability and achievement tests.
Interpret the results to determine students' strengths and needs.

tasks.design: She administers the standardized ability and achievement tests, then interprets the results and determines each student's strengths and needs. No tool is added, and nothing is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Strengths and needs are judged from the result and from the student, not from a score alone.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new administers the standardized test or names the need.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong reading of the result can set the wrong support.
tasks.human_edge: She determines the student's strengths and needs.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still gives the standardized tests and interprets the results.

reach.task: Seat the student and keep the standardized test free of prompts.
reach.learn: Which accommodations the test allows for this student.

evidence.claim: AI that watches tests is high-risk.
Texas machine-scores state tests; rescoring requests rose from 2,758 in 2024 to 64,489 in 2026.

assumptions: Her boundary is the standardized test she administers and the interpretation she writes. She does not send the result outside the organisation.
The interpretation records the student, the test, the result and the strength or need. She writes them from the test result. An empty result stays empty.
Writing the interpretation is her own entry inside the organisation. It is not a machine commit.
Upkeep is zero because no tool is added. Share 60 is giving the test (in-person prior 59.4). Share 40 is the interpretation (documents 27.6 and the other means together 13.0).
unknowns: Whether a published standardized test already returns a score before she interprets it.
research_questions: Which standardized tests must she administer herself?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Giving the standardized tests and interpreting the results stay as they are. A week of the same tests still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet parents to teach skills and name community resources.

steps.what: Meet with parents and guardians to teach skills for dealing with students' impairments.
Provide guidance on the community resources that fit the impairment.

tasks.design: She meets parents and guardians, teaches skills for dealing with the student's impairment, and writes the community resources she named. No tool is added, and nothing is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The guidance depends on the family in the room and on the impairment.
tasks.still_hard: The wrong skill or the wrong resource can leave the family without support.
tasks.human_edge: She teaches the skills the family can use.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still meets the parents and names the resources.

reach.task: Welcome the parents and guardians and note who attended.
reach.learn: Which impairment the meeting is about.

evidence.claim: The meeting with parents and guardians stays with the teacher.
Under the WMS, staff consent to tools that can monitor them, and parents and pupils consent to pupil-data rules.

assumptions: Her boundary is the meeting with parents and guardians. The conversation is in the room. She does not send anything outside the organisation.
The resource note records the student, the impairment and the community resource she named. She writes them from the guidance she gave. An empty resource stays empty.
Writing the note is her own entry inside the organisation. It is not a machine commit.
Upkeep is zero because no tool is added. Share 82 is the meeting (in-person prior 81.4). Share 18 is the resource note (documents 10.8 and the other means together 7.9).
unknowns: Which community resources this family is already using.
research_questions: Which community resources may she name for this impairment?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The parent meeting and the resource guidance stay as they are. A week of the same meetings still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still prepares each class, gives and grades the tests, and meets parents about the impairment. Nothing is drafted for her.
reach: The teaching assistant lays out the test paper and welcomes the parents so she can give the test and teach the skills.
skills_to_grow: Which accommodations a standardized test allows, and which community resources the family already uses.
role.ambitious_version: She still interprets standardized results herself and still teaches parents the skills for the impairment. The lesson plan remains the evidence she writes.
